totalNodesCount.description: Number of nodes in the next wave's trail. More nodes mean a longer visual search and higher load.
totalNodesCount.adjustment_guide: relax: 5-8. focus: 10-12. grit: 15-20. Change by at most 2-3 nodes between waves.

rotateNodesAroundUser.description: Whether the nodes slowly orbit the player, so targets keep moving.
rotateNodesAroundUser.adjustment_guide: relax: false. focus and grit: true once the player is completing waves cleanly.

rotationSpeed.description: Orbit speed in degrees per second when rotateNodesAroundUser is true.
rotationSpeed.adjustment_guide: focus: 3-5. grit: 8-12. Ignored while rotation is off.

nodeDimension.description: What the nodes show: 0 = numbers (1,2,3), 1 = letters (A,B,C), 2 = alternating numbers and letters (1,A,2,B), 3 = emojis. Higher values demand more cognitive flexibility.
nodeDimension.adjustment_guide: relax: 0. focus: 0 or 1, move to 2 only when waves are error-free. grit: 2 or 3.

arrowHelpfulness.description: Guidance toward the next node: 0 = none, 1 = off-screen directional arrow, 2 = arrow plus on-screen highlight.

adjustment_instructions:
You are adjusting parameters for Trails WebAR, an immersive spatial trail-making game played in waves. Each wave (or level) is one trail of nodes the player connects in order by looking at (or pointing at) each node. The values you output are applied at the start of the NEXT wave, never mid-wave, so decide for the wave as a whole.

Wave outcomes arrive as LEVEL_COMPLETE events with the measured completion time versus the ideal time, the number of wrong-node errors and the path efficiency (ideal path length / path actually travelled).

Target mood guidance:
- relax: short trails (totalNodesCount 5-8), no rotation, numbers only (nodeDimension 0), full guidance (arrowHelpfulness 2). Finding nodes should feel effortless and unhurried.
- focus: standard trails (totalNodesCount 10-12), slow rotation (rotateNodesAroundUser true, rotationSpeed 3-5), numbers or letters, medium guidance (arrowHelpfulness 1). Sustained attention without frustration: if a wave had 3+ errors or took over 1.6x the ideal time, ease one notch; if it was error-free and under 1.1x ideal for two waves, add a notch.
- grit: long trails (totalNodesCount 15-20), faster rotation (8-12), alternating or emoji sequences (nodeDimension 2-3), no guidance (arrowHelpfulness 0).

Always move gradually from the current values: at most 2-3 nodes, one nodeDimension step and one arrowHelpfulness step per wave. Keep the player inside the target mood rather than chasing maximum difficulty.
notes: Trails WebAR's adaptive knobs, matching parameters.json, the game's ApplyParameterAdjustment handler and GameAdjustmentTester's 'trails-webar' keys. Mirrors api_backend/scripts/seed-trails-scoring.sh in the marketplace repo.
